title: Agent Rules config
markdownDescription: Configures the Agent Rules sync script. See `scripts/agent-rules/README.md`.

source.markdownDescription:
Folder with the rules (the source of truth). Only edit the rules here; the copies are overwritten on every run.

Defaults to `.agents/rules/`.

targets.markdownDescription:
Harnesses that get a copy of every rule.

Defaults to Claude (`.claude/rules/`) and GitHub Copilot (`.github/instructions/`). Removing a target doesn't delete its existing copies.

folder.markdownDescription: Folder the copies are written to, e.g. `.claude/rules/`.

fileName.markdownDescription:
File name of each copy. `{name}` is the rule's file name without `.md`, e.g. `"{name}.instructions.md"`.

Must contain `{name}` and end with `.md` or `.mdc`. Two targets can't write to the same file.

frontmatter.markdownDescription:
Keys written to each copy's frontmatter, on top of the rule's own keys (except `paths`).

- `$paths` writes the rule's paths as a YAML list.
- `$pathsCsv` writes them as one comma-separated string.
- Any other value is written as is.

additionalProperties.markdownDescription: `$paths` (YAML list of the rule's paths), `$pathsCsv` (comma-separated string) or any literal value.

indexFile.markdownDescription:
Always-on instructions file that gets a generated index of the rules, for harnesses without rule folders (Codex). The index is written between the `<!-- agent-rules:start -->` and `<!-- agent-rules:end -->` markers.

Defaults to `AGENTS.md`; set to `""` to skip the index.
